market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance (~$300B private valuation) would likely be the largest IPO in 2026 if it goes public. The probability of an IPO this year is low but not zero—around 2%—given ongoing U.S. regulatory pressures and a potential Hong Kong listing restart. The market’s implied ~0.2% probability appears too pessimistic, leaving a large positive edge for Yes.
evidence_points: ByteDance is one of the most valuable private companies globally, with a valuation exceeding $300 billion.
A Hong Kong IPO was previously prepared but paused; it could be revived if U.S. or Chinese regulatory conditions improve.
Other large private companies (e.g., SpaceX, OpenAI) have signaled no near-term IPO plans, reducing competition for the highest 2026 IPO market cap.
sources_consulted: Public news reports (Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC) on ByteDance valuation and IPO status
